headline: Road Accidents Claim Over 490 Lives This Year
content: From January through June of this year, there have been 1,813 road accidents resulting in 482 fatalities and 3,501 injuries, reported by the National Police Directorate Traffic Division. These numbers show significant increases compared to last year during the same period where there were 3,327 incidents leaving behind 772 deaths. Specifically, fatal cases increased by 28%, while injured individuals rose by 14%. The majority of these mishaps occurred within vehicles registered for public transport services across various regions including Lima leading with 25%, followed by Junín at 11%, Arequipa at 10%, Ancash also at 10%, La Libertad at 7%, among others such as Piura, Cajamarca, Lambayeque each accounting for about 4% of occurrences. As stated by Transport and Communications Commission head, Mr. Juan Quesada, most accidents stem primarily from human error constituting around 84% which includes excessive speed and driver recklessness contributing significantly towards these statistics. Superintendent Transportation Land Passenger Goods and Services committed further operations aimed at reducing future incidences.
